en.headline: Korean Mid-Autumn festival week opens at Central Market
en.dek: A seven-day free programme of K-food, beauty workshops and performances runs from today through 27 September, with a Full Moon Party on festival night.
body: A Mid-Autumn K-Festival Week opened at Central Market today, turning the three-floor heritage market into a week-long showcase of Korean food, beauty and culture through 27 September.

The event is organised by the Korean Chamber of Commerce in Hong Kong, the Hong Kong branch of the Korea Agro-Fisheries and Food Trade Corporation and Central Market, under the patronage of the Consulate General of the Republic of Korea and with support from Invest Hong Kong. Admission is free. Organisers said the programme is timed to overlap Hong Kong’s Mid-Autumn Festival with Korea’s Chuseok harvest holiday.

Highlights listed by the organisers include daily cooking demonstrations by three chefs who appeared on the Netflix series Culinary Class Wars, a Korean food marketplace, K-beauty workshops and daily performances. Hours are 11am to 9pm. A Full Moon Party is scheduled for 25 September from 6.30pm to 9pm.
Central Market is at 93 Queen’s Road Central. The week sits alongside other Mid-Autumn programmes already running across the city, including lantern displays at Victoria Park and Tsim Sha Tsui.

zh.headline: 中環街市中秋韓風周今日開鑾
zh.dek: 為期七天的免費韓食、美妝工作坊及表演由今日起至9月27日在中環街市舉行，中秋正日另有滿月派對。
body: 中環街市今日起舉辦中秋韓風周，把三層歷史建築變成韓國飲食、美妝及文化展覽場地，活動持續至9月27日。
活動由香港韓人商會、韓國農水產食品流通公社香港支部及中環街市合辦，獲駐港韓國總領事館支持，並有投資推廣署協助。入場免費。主辦單位表示，檔期刻意對上香港中秋節與韓國秋夕。
已公布的重點包括Netflix節目《黑白大廚》三位廚師每日示範烹調、韓食市集、K-beauty工作坊及每日表演，開放時間上午11時至晚上9時。9月25日晚上6時半至9時另設滿月派對。
中環街市地址為皇后大道中93號。活動與維園及尖沙咀一帶已展開的中秋綵燈同屬本月節日節目。
